invariants.rationale: The method returns a newly created HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is a parameter and typically a non-null String representing commit timestamp.
records is a parameter representing the list of records to insert; it should not be null.
The write statuses list inside result is expected to be non-null after a successful insert.
The number of write statuses should logically not exceed the number of records inserted.
